name: code-oracle-mcp
description: Multi-language type-aware resolution MCP over a warm LSP session (tsgo for TS/JS, ty for Python) — sibling to code-map. Isolated here so code-map's core stays zero-heavy-dep.
_dependencyNote: tsgo is a daily preview build (preview churn) — pinned EXACT to a known-good day, not a floating caret, so a standalone install reproduces. Bump deliberately. Python uses ty via `uvx ty server` + python3 (no npm pin).
